notes: Blood Glucose Buddy is now a menu bar app first. Showing your reading on Discord is an optional extra, off for new users. If you used 1.0, it stays on.
Discord's options now live together in a Discord menu and their own section in Settings.
Sharper pictures on Discord, and an app icon without white corners.
First release for Mac: your Dexcom reading and trend arrow in the menu bar and on your Discord profile, refreshed every five minutes.
Number mode or colored-dot-only mode, mg/dL or mmol/L, and Watching or Playing.
Find My Account ID, for Dexcom accounts that won't sign in with email or phone.
Starts at login. Your Dexcom password lives in your Mac's Keychain.
